policy_note: This ledger tracks upstream-only changes that are evaluated topic-by-topic for intentional adoption into the long-lived productized fork.

freshness_policy.refresh_cadence: Refresh the live_git_truth block by manually dispatching the upstream-drift workflow immediately before any planning wave that cites current counts or topology conclusions. Historical entries remain planning context and must not be promoted back into current truth without a fresh live sample.
freshness_policy.stale_snapshot_rule: Counts, topology notes, and portability conclusions are current only through observed_at_utc for the block that declares them. After refresh_required_after_utc, they are historical context and must be refreshed before being cited as current truth.
freshness_policy.missing_metadata_rule: A selective-port snapshot without freshness metadata is invalid for current governance.

live_git_truth.current_truth_boundary: This block is the authoritative current Git-topology sample for origin/main versus upstream/main. It is the only place in this ledger that may be cited as current topology truth, and CI must validate it against the live refs before treating any selective-port planning statement as current. Historical entries under entries[] remain planning context only, even when they are still inside their freshness window.
live_git_truth.summary: Live Git sampling on 2026-04-07 still found no merge-base between origin/main and upstream/main. The current fork must therefore continue to be treated as a long-lived productized selective-port branch with broken ancestry for ordinary merge/rebase storytelling. Current ref counts are origin_only=9 and upstream_only=654.
live_git_truth.topology_warning: Do not cite historical entry counts as current truth while this block disagrees with them. Refresh live_git_truth first, then decide whether any historical planning entry should be refreshed or left as archival planning context.

entries.decision_note: Do not default to merge/rebase. Treat the current red strict-drift signal as evidence of a real behind-upstream backlog, not as permission to rewrite the policy.
